intended_object: This is an auxiliary sequence of profiles used inside the library's proof about Navier–Stokes self-similar profiles (axis source regularity). Given a sequence v, it is 0 at index 0, and at index k+1 it is the operator Z2 applied with order slowOrder h k − 1 to v k. I inferred this from the body and its use in SlowRecursion.lean.
explanation: The definition is an internal helper for the library's proof. It is used to factor `shiftedAxial` as w.1 times this factor, and then to prove smoothness and analyticity at points on the axis. It has no standard counterpart in the mathematical literature. Its docstring only restates its body.
